notes: v203: Two new events to host, every year (Economy tab → Sporting Events & Summits). The Champions League Final, for European (UEFA) countries: ticket and broadcast earnings, tourism and a lift in national mood. The G20 Leaders' Summit, for the world's 20 largest economies (annexed land counts): every G20 member's relations with you rise, approval goes up. Bid a year ahead; hosts rotate, so a recent host rarely wins again straight away.
